Daily Devotional

August 4

7 And in the same house remain, eating and drinking such things as they give: for the labourer is worthy of his hire. Go not from house to house. (Luke 10:7 KJV)

This is where Jesus was sending 70 disciples out to announce His coming into their towns and to teach, preach, and heal. He is telling them that they need not provide for their upkeep, as the minister should live by his labors. This is letting the Church know that all preachers, ministers, teachers and other people who serve the Lord full time, should expect to receive their livelihood from the people they minister to.

Jesus told the same thing to the 12 disciples when He sent them out to preach and heal the sick (Matthew 10:11, Mark 6:10, Luke 9:4). Even though most preachers are not in the service to the Lord for the money, they should be well provided for, as what is more important then our salvation and spiritual knowledge of our God. All Pastors should be rewarded in accordance to their service to the Lord, and those that do a great job of teaching the Word, should be well rewarded (1 Timothy 5:17), but those that do not do a proper job of service to the body of Christ, should not be rewarded. If all Christians would truly give only to where they are fed the Word, then the kingdom of God would be better taken care of. You should not give to a dead church, or one that does not stay with the Word of God!

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
